name: Ancamna

attributes.attribute: mother goddess of prosperity and healing

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ancamna is a Continental Celtic goddess. She was the consort of Mars. Mars is the Roman name the Romans gave to many Celtic war gods; it was not her partner’s original name. Ancamna appears to have been a mother goddess of prosperity and healing.
objective: Record Ancamna, a Continental Celtic goddess.
key_results: Show her role as consort of Mars.
Show her as a mother goddess of prosperity and healing.
